_comment: Single source of truth for external plugin dependencies hypoc's own installer (bin/install) provisions for the user. Mirrors bmxoc's versions.json pattern: pin known-good versions here, read from here in the installer, update in one place when bumping.

ecc-universal.notes: Referenced in .opencode.json's plugin array and required by .opencode/plugins/skill-discovery.ts, which resolves its skills/ directory at runtime. Previously assumed pre-installed; no installer ever actually provisioned it.

superpowers.notes: Referenced in .opencode.json's plugin array. Its .opencode/plugins/superpowers.js already exports a proper function-factory plugin (SuperpowersPlugin), but as a named export, not `export default`, and package.json also declares a separate pi.extensions entry point. Whether opencode's plugin-array loader (as opposed to opencode's .opencode/plugins/*.ts auto-discovery) still loads this on opencode >= 1.18 is an open upstream question, not something this installer can fix on its own. This installer's job is limited to making sure the package is actually present on disk at a pinned version instead of silently absent.
